title: Wakir Datalog Caveat (Phase 1b Wirelang vocabulary v0.2)
description: JSON Schema for the array of Datalog caveat statements that can appear inside a Layer-3 capability token's authority_block.caveats and append_blocks[*].caveats. The schema encodes the Wakir Phase-1b vocabulary: 20 Phase-1a (v0.1) predicates plus 2 Phase-1b federation predicates (peer_org, federation_route) ratified in datalog-caveat-vocabulary-phase-2.md §3.2 / §5. Predicate-argument-type checking beyond the surface syntax is performed at Biscuit-Datalog evaluation time, not by this schema. Class R (reserved) and Class P (patch-eligible) predicates are deliberately NOT admitted by this schema; producers that emit them fail at validation time. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

items.description: A single Datalog caveat statement. Wakir Phase-1b vocabulary recognises 22 schema-admitted predicates (see datalog-caveat-vocabulary.md and datalog-caveat-vocabulary-phase-2.md §7). The pattern below admits `<predicate>(<arg-list>)` syntax where the predicate is one of the registered Wakir predicates and the argument list contains the expected number of comma-separated tokens. Variable references are written `$name`. Caveats that compose multiple predicates (e.g. `time($t), $t < 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z`) are admitted as a comma-separated chain.

$comment: The pattern restricts the leading predicate name to the schema-admitted Wakir vocabulary (Class N1 + Class N2). Argument-list contents are deliberately permissive (`[^)]*`) because Datalog supports a rich set of argument forms (literals, variables, comparators); type-level validation lives in the Biscuit-Datalog evaluator. This schema is the syntactic gate for static-analysis tooling and registry-side checks; it is NOT the security boundary. Class R (zk_proof_valid, zk_reputation_threshold, cross_org_quota, persona_state, persona_attested_after, wat_inclusion_proof_valid) and Class P (persona_pin, caveat_hash) predicates are reserved at the vocabulary level but not admitted at the schema level — producers fail-closed at validate time.
